digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow routing and documentation gates
propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must select a reduced Verify lane that runs only documentation gates while skipping the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, artifact, eval, golden-path, and identity jobs.

A trusted classifier job executing only from origin/main must decide routing based on whether all changed paths are in the allowlisted documentation set; any Python, shell, workflow, dependency, test, configuration, or unrecognized path must select full Verify with fail-closed fallback.

Documentation gate definitions must be extracted into a shared composite action (.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml) that retains ADR validation, index/cross-reference checks, README quickstart, and drift validation, with no additional runner job for the full lane.

The classifier logic and complete allowlist execute only from trusted origin/main using a sparse checkout and separate credential-disabled verification, never importing or executing patchset-controlled code, with output failure still triggering full-route jobs and blocking Verified.

All structural test consumers of _build-and-test.yml (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_check_adr_numbers_heldout.py, etc.) must be migrated to follow extracted gates without weakening existing assertions or deleting affected invariants.

Classifier and docs-only job results must be integrated into vote.needs with route-aware normalization so exactly one route executes, classifier failure blocks Verified even when fallback jobs pass, and docs-gate failure prevents Verified +1.
